art_method: Exact native FMesher surfaces; orthographic editorial lighting, authored palette; not an Unreal screenshot. No invented room plan or damage.

fitting_contract.admission: Capabilities only. Each candidate still requires native material, clearance, power, construction and campaign admission. Existing installed recipes keep their recorded revision.

crew_accommodation.notes: Five disjoint departments. Operators are ship operating crew; troops include marine/operator detachments. Aircraft retain their own pilots. Spare bunks do not create personnel. Legacy accommodation is unknown. Life-support rating is operating capacity, not an atmosphere/endurance or casualty simulation.
